output: SELECT s.name AS station_name, MAX(julianday(m.resolved_on) - julianday(m.reported_on)) AS longest_days FROM station s JOIN bike b ON b.station_id = s.station_id JOIN maintenance m ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id WHERE m.resolved_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name ORDER BY longest_days DESC;
